headlines.title: Visa Partners Singapore Tourism Board to Strengthen Singapore's Global Destination Appeal
headlines.summary: Visa, a global leader in digital payments and the Singapore Tourism Board (STB) have signed a three-year Memorandum of Understanding (MOU) to strengthen Singapore's appeal as a preferred travel destination and to unlock new growth opportunities.

headlines.title: CodeCoin Launches Quantum-Secured Visa-Network Payment Card at IMF Annual Meetings in Bangkok
headlines.summary: CodeCoin Launches Quantum-Secured Visa-Network Payment Card at IMF Annual Meetings in Bangkok CodeCoin Bangkok, Thailand, Oct. 22, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- CodeCoin announces its new digital payment card, a technology partnership with Dune Fintech, strategic MOUs and a Southeast Asia fintech policy Green Paper.

headlines.title: Visa, Mastercard bet on AI, crypto ahead of earnings
headlines.summary: With the big card companies scheduled to issue quarterly reports next week, they're releasing a number of products that support digital assets and artificial intelligence.

headlines.title: Visa and Mastercard tokenization fees could support revenue growth, UBS says
headlines.summary: Visa Inc (NYSE:V, XETRA:3V64) and Mastercard Inc (NYSE:MA) could generate a growing stream of revenue from payment tokenization as digital transactions expand and card networks charge for technology that helps secure payments and reduce fraud, according to UBS.

headlines.title: Visa (V) Unveils New Commercial Payment Tools, Is The Stock Fully Valued?
headlines.summary: Visa (V) just rolled out three new commercial payment capabilities that lean heavily on AI, virtual card security and trusted agent technology, giving investors fresh detail on how the network is approaching commercial-card demand. The new commercial payment tools land at a moment when Visa’s share price has been climbing, with a recent push to a 52-week high. A 30-day share price return of 10.24% and a 1-year total shareholder return of 19.

description: Visa Inc. operates as a payment technology company in the United States and internationally. The company operates VisaNet, a transaction processing network that enables authorization, clearing, and settlement of payment transactions. It also offers credit, debit, and prepaid card products; tap to pay, tokenization, and click to pay services; Visa Direct, a platform which facilitates money movement, enabling clients to collect, hold, convert, and send funds across its network; and issuing solutions, such as airport lounge access, dining reservations, shopping experiences, event tickets, and seller offers. In addition, the company provides acceptance solutions, an omnichannel payment integration with e-commerce platforms; risk detection and prevention solutions; and advisory and other services comprising consulting practice, proprietary analytics models, data scientists and economists, marketing services, and managed services. It provides its services under the Visa, Visa Electron, V PAY, Interlink, and PLUS brands. The company serves consumers, sellers, financial institutions, and government entities. Visa Inc. was founded in 1958 and is headquartered in San Francisco, California.
